rav-adda-bar-avin.name: Rav Adda bar Avin
rav-adda-bar-avin.bio: Amora who explains in Keritot 21a that the baraita’s “so too every” includes the blood of a koy.
rav-adda-bar-avin.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a greying brown beard and a tan wool mantle, explaining a baraita with an open hand; background of a plain study hall with a scroll shelf and an oil lamp.
